reason: J.B. Hunt is a North American land-based freight provider covering intermodal rail, dedicated trucking, brokerage and final-mile delivery for retail, consumer and manufacturing shippers. Genco owns ocean dry bulk vessels and charters them to miners, steelmakers and commodity traders worldwide. Both are asset-based freight carriers paid per movement or charter. The mode, the service and the buyers all differ: container and truck freight for retailers versus Capesize and Supramax charters for bulk commodities. The only link is the broad label of freight transportation.
reason_if_0: Different customers: J.B. Hunt sells land freight and logistics to retail, consumer goods and e-commerce shippers. Genco sells ocean dry bulk vessel charters to commodity charterers.
